annotations.title: Take somebody out of a company

description: Removes a member from a company, now: they stop reading and writing its books. Needs members.manage, except to leave a company yourself. The last owner of a company is refused, themself included; make somebody else owner with set_member_role first. Their pending invitations are not touched. Say who is being removed before calling it.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

user_id.description: The member to take out. Your own id leaves the company, which needs no members.manage.

name: remove_member
